g.text: Equal session means within each person, then equal people. Budget curves use only the same [302, 600) s suffix.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #697785

g.text: Left: [122, 600) s at 120 s calibration. Shaded stale mapping uses no fresh-session labels.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #697785

g.text: Right: 9 people and 26 identical sessions across both budgets and all three curves; 0 unpaired sessions excluded.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #697785

g.text: Primary 120 s and primary 300 s windows are never compared as a label-budget effect. Intervals are descriptive, not clinical claims.
